answer: A fresh clone starts on bare shale with no sealed grading history, and that record is the one thing it cannot backfill. On Proof of Agent an identity gains weight only from quorum-matched grading verdicts it sealed on-ledger, one epoch at a time, each re-checked against consensus. Trust grows slow like a grove, not spread cheap across a meadow; it cannot be minted or handed to a clone. A thousand fakes each repay a thousand times the honest judgment labor, so the sybil bill is linear in identities and never shared.
